subject: Onboarding credit matrix and usage escrow plan for Novum Analytics
messages:
From: Sophie Lang <sophie@novum.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 23 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding credit questions and pilot structure

Hey Vivek —

Thanks for the demo this week. We loved the latency benchmarks and the routing options, and the team is keen to run a short pilot across two internal apps (search re-ranking and a knowledge-base generator). Before we lock dates, procurement asked for clarity on three items:

1) How credits get applied during a pilot versus after a commit (is there an escrow or staged release?).
2) Whether unused pilot credits roll into a committed bucket or expire.
3) Any minimum commit required to unlock credits beyond the starter voucher.

I attached a rough SOW that PMs shared. Would appreciate a short note with the proposed flow so I can take it to procurement next week.

Best,
Sophie
Senior Product Manager — Novum Analytics
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Lang <sophie@novum.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding credit questions and pilot structure

Hi Sophie —

Appreciate the fast follow. Short answers up front, and I pasted a proposed staged-credit flow below. Marissa and I can walk procurement through the mechanics if that helps.

Quick answers:
- Escrow & staged release: We support a timebound escrow where pilot credits are deposited and released in tranches based on milestones (e.g., pilot kickoff, mid-pilot check, production sign-off).
- Unused credits: By default pilot credits expire after 90 days, but with a signed commit they can be rolled into the committed balance pro rata (subject to the committed contract).
- Minimum commit: No strict minimum to get the starter voucher, but tiered additional credits kick in at 3M tokens/month committed for a 6-month term (we can be flexible for strategic pilots).

Proposed staged-credit flow (high level):
1) Deposit: Redwood issues pilot credits (X tokens) into an escrow entry tied to the Novum deal on our payments platform.
2) Kickoff release: 30% of credits unlocked at pilot kickoff once SOW countersigned.
3) Midpoint validation: 40% released after shared evals and perf checks.
4) Conversion / final tranche: Remaining 30% released on production sign-off OR automatically converted into committed credits if Novum signs a commit by T+30 days.

I'll attach a sample commit schedule and our credit-terms doc. If procurement needs escrow via a third-party escrow provider or a PO workflow instead of our standard terms, we can map that out.

Would you like a short call with procurement Wednesday (May 27) or should we send a one-page flow for review?

Thanks,
Vivek
Head of Commercial Ops — Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 26 May 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Onboarding credit questions and pilot structure

Vivek — quick internal note before procurement call.

A few negotiation levers I suggest we highlight:
- Time-bound conversion window: Offer a 45-day conversion window (instead of 30) for strategic logos; increases likelihood they convert leftover credits.
- Performance SLA uplift: For pilot workloads we can provide a one-time 5% credit refund if latency SLOs miss by >20% (this is a limited offer).
- Escrow alternatives: We should propose a middle ground: Redwood-managed escrow + monthly usage reports tied to HubSpot deal as evidence (less friction than third-party escrow).

I'll bring updated numbers to the call; low risk to be flexible on the commit threshold for first-time enterprise pilots (e.g., 2M tokens/month for 6 months instead of 3M).

-Marissa
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference

Sophie / procurement team —

Attached are the one-page flow, the sample DocuSign SOW, and an amendment template that converts unused pilot credits pro rata into the committed bucket. Key notes:

- Flow: 30/40/30 tranche release by default; offering a 45-day conversion window for strategic pilots (Novum is eligible).
- Conversion math: Unused pilot credits convert at retail discount tied to the committed tier signed. For example, if they sign 2M tokens/month at the 10% commit discount, converted credits receive the same per-token rate and are applied to the committed billing cycle.
- Escrow: Redwood-managed escrow — we provide monthly usage export and a HubSpot link (see deal link). If procurement still requires a third-party escrow, legal can accept a limited escrow addendum.

Next steps:
1) Sophie/procurement confirms acceptance of the 45-day conversion window.
2) If yes, we issue the DocuSign bundle and deposit the initial pilot credits to escrow.
3) Kickoff call scheduled for June 2.

Thanks — prepping the DocuSign now.

Best,
Vivek
Head of Commercial Ops — Redwood Inference
